srList.sentence: The study inclusion criteria were: definitive diagnosis of MS based on the 2010 revision of McDonald criteria, 17 age more than or equal to 18 years, mental ability to answer questions, stable clinical status (lack of recurrence in the past 3 months and of disability worsening, defined as 1.0-point increase if baseline EDSS score was < 5.5 or 0.5-point increase if baseline EDSS score was >= 5.5 confirmed 6 months apart and sustained at the end of the follow-up period), 18 lack of LUTS before the onset of MS, lack of history of pelvic surgeryradiotherapy or bladder stones and lack of history of benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) or prostate surgery (through patient self-report).
